feeds.title: Pentecostal Publishing House Blog
feeds.description: Pentecostal Publishing House is the official publishing entity of the United Pentecostal Church International. The purpose of PPH is to aid the cause of spreading the whole gospel through the production of literature, books, tracts, eBooks, media & periodicals, and more.

feeds.title: Flower Pentecostal Heritage Center
feeds.description: The Flower Pentecostal Heritage Center (FPHC) is the largest Pentecostal archive in the world. Located in the National Office of the Assemblies of God USA, the FPHC collects printed materials, oral histories, artifacts, photographs, and memorabilia documenting the Assemblies of God and the broader Pentecostal and charismatic movements, spanning the globe.

feeds.title: Comox Pentecostal Church Blog
feeds.description: We are a bunch of ordinary people who love God and love people. This Church exists to worship God and connect people to Jesus by whatever means necessary, our hope is to be the loving feet of Jesus that move toward people of all walks of life, and his hands working toward restoring brokenness in our world.

feeds.title: TPC of Waco Blog
feeds.description: Greetings, this is my spot to chit-chat about things that I am passionate about. I will share my ruminations and opinions here. My goal is to share the convictions of the Word of God because it is the only thing that will sustain us throughout everything that we will ever face.

feeds.title: Andrew K. Gabriel
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Dr. Andrew, a Pentecostal Theologian. I write to invite Christians to think well so that they can affirm and live out their faith with biblical and spiritual integrity. Sometimes my posts will inspire you. Sometimes they will challenge your thinking.

feeds.title: Ryan A. French
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Ryan French. Thanks for taking the time to click around on my blog. Hopefully, you will find my ramblings helpful, or at the very least, slightly inspirational. Apostolic voice is a Christian blog and podcast that discusses biblical topics from a Pentecostal viewpoint. It contains book reviews and a bookstore.

feeds.title: Stanley Pentecostal Holiness Church Blog
feeds.description: Stanley Pentecostal Holiness Church is a place where people can meet Jesus, believers can engage in a life-giving community, and everyone is welcome. We believe in creating a place where people can have an authentic encounter with Jesus Christ, discover the gifts of the spirit, as well as their personal gifts, and use them for His glory.

feeds.title: Apostolic Pentecostal Blog
feeds.description: I am an ordained minister with the Associated Brotherhood of Christians. My wife, Dr. Sharon Starcher, and I live on a family farm that grows raisin grapes in Fresno, California. My academic degrees include M.Ed., MBA, M.Div., and D.Min. In addition to teaching business, leadership, and ethics courses at Fresno Pacific, I am developing Pentecostal Spiritual Formation resources for the Christosis Network

feeds.title: The Apostolic Housewife
feeds.description: The day to day of a mother, woman of God, an apostolic pentecostal housewife.

feeds.title: Summit Pentecostal Blog
feeds.description: Summit Pentecostal Blog shares insights, thoughts, stories, and victories along the way. Summit Pentecostal Church is led by Pastor Brian Smithson. For over 25 years, Pastor Brian has helped Christians and people new to Christianity understand the Bible and go deeper in their faith.

feeds.title: Asian Center for Pentecostal Theology Blog
feeds.description: The Asian Center of Pentecostal Theology (ACPT) was started in 2015 by Robert Menzies. The ACPT seeks to strengthen the church in Asia by promoting Pentecostal theology, ministry, and experience in the region. The ACPT seeks to be: A meeting place for a community of pastors and scholars committed to Pentecostal values and ministry; a digital library of books, articles, book reviews, and blogs that seek to bring clarity to the Pentecostal message and encourage the Church in its mission.

feeds.title: New Life United Pentecostal Church Blog
feeds.description: New Life UPC is a United Pentecostal Church dedicated to loving people, teaching the truth of God's Word, and reaching the lost with this glorious gospel.

feeds.title: United Pentecostal Church Blog
feeds.description: Whether you are looking for a church home or you're considering coming to church for the very first time we are glad you're here. If you have never had the opportunity to be in a spirit-filled service before, you will discover that the oldest worship on earth is a brand new experience for you.
